summary: @servicetitan/grid preinstall executes obfuscated Bun payload via downloaded Bun runtime
details: package.json declares `scripts.preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a pinned Bun binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against `math_init.js` — a ~727KB heavily obfuscated `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle shipped in the package (control-flow/string-array obfuscation, rotated numeric constants array, name-mangled identifiers). `math_init.js` is not referenced by `dist/index.js` and has no connection to a React data grid; its sole purpose is to be executed by the freshly-downloaded Bun runtime at `npm install` time. The `dist/` tree resembles a Kendo-based grid, providing cover, while `setup.mjs` + `math_init.js` deliver the payload. The package is published under the `@servicetitan` scope but ships behavior unrelated to that brand's stated business. Using an alternate runtime to execute an opaque, package-local bundle at install time yields arbitrary code execution on the installer's host and bypasses Node-based scanners that cannot introspect the Bun-CJS bundle.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
